description: Shell script for testing CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) conversion and line ending normalization in a Git repository. Contains functions for creating gitattributes, comparing files, and performing various tests on line ending conversions under different configurations.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after transforming line endings, checks for differences, and cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares two files with special transformations to handle whitespace and line ending variations.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes for testing line ending normalization.

methods.name: create_NNO_MIX_files
methods.description: Creates sets of test files with different line endings and attributes for testing.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks for expected warning messages during git operations related to line ending conversions.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs a series of git add and commit operations with different attributes and checks for warnings.

methods.name: commit_chk_wrnNNO
methods.description: Sets up and commits files with specific attributes and checks for expected warnings in NNO files.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Commits files with mixed line endings and checks for warnings.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Returns a string representing the line ending style based on input.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Generates a string representing git attribute settings based on input parameters.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Compares files in the repository against expected files for line ending correctness.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Checks files in the repository for NNO (not normalized) line endings against expected files.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Tests checkout of files with various attributes and configurations, verifying line endings and warnings.
